name: Mashiro Tomoya
source:
An average guy, for better or worse. Besides being an idol, he is also an aspiring actor. While Tomoya is serious and caring, he is easily swayed by his surroundings. With a mild, humble voice, he delivers energetic, vigorous performances.

The leader of Rhythm Link's Ra*bits.

[From in-game profile]
